scope: Focused primary-source review of 12 selected papers and their latest checked versions. Not exhaustive, not proof of novelty. Most recent sources are preprints. Findings, author directions and our adaptations are distinct.

sources.title: NinaXander
sources.finding: A shared connector joins frozen language models from two different architecture families. No joined model matches the stronger parent. Reconstruction and transfer to another text domain remain weak.
sources.author_direction: Choose parents with complementary strengths. Improve reconstruction, train across domains, test repeated switches and repeat across seeds.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Check that each part adds useful information. A working wire between models is already established prior work.

sources.title: Draft-KV
sources.finding: In several earlier systems, unrelated messages barely changed accuracy. Draft-KV trains useful communication and also tests models with different private evidence.
sources.author_direction: The paper demonstrates matched-message, wrong-message and receiver-alone controls. It separates the benefit of correct messages from the damage caused by wrong ones.
sources.direction_kind: Demonstrated method lesson; not a quoted future-work recommendation
sources.our_experiment_change: Use both comparisons. A large correct-versus-wrong gap alone can hide a system that gains little from correct messages.

sources.title: Right Answer, Wrong Mechanism
sources.finding: An internal patch can get the right answer through a planted alternative pathway. The revision tests models up to 7B parameters. Its tests do not establish how common this is in natural models.
sources.author_direction: Detecting alternative pathways whose individual units stay within normal ranges remains open. Broader downstream checks and stricter natural reference sets are needed.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Call our next result an effect of a controlled intervention. Correct answers and normal-looking signal sizes cannot prove that the native reasoning process was recovered.

sources.title: Are We Recovering Mechanisms?
sources.finding: Scores used to judge recovered circuits can disagree with an independently fixed behavior test. Output agreement alone does not identify a unique mechanism.
sources.author_direction: Report behavioral deficits alongside circuit scores. Compare multiple measures and interventions, and control circuit size and intervention choices.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Report answer choices, ties and score changes separately. Keep all cases. Do not select a favorable score after seeing the result.

sources.title: JEPA-Anything
sources.finding: The model combines predictive factors across several data types. Geometric separation of these factors does not guarantee separate meanings or causes. Gains do not occur in every control environment.
sources.author_direction: Use predictive components in systems that choose interventions, compare expected and observed outcomes, and use errors to guide the next experiment.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: For a later world-model organ, use a small environment with known rules and meaningful action changes. Compare a learned energy scorer with an ordinary predictor and an exact simulator.

sources.title: The Planning Limits of Latent World Models
sources.finding: Planning can fail when a goal is much farther away than the model can reliably predict. Even an exact simulator suffers under a short planning horizon. Easy random action comparisons can hide differences.
sources.author_direction: Generate useful subgoals without access to an expert rollout. Balance prediction horizon and search budget. Test harder nearby action alternatives; many comparisons still need more seeds.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Match the prediction and goal horizons. Separate predictor errors from planner errors with an exact-model control. Harder questions must isolate a cause, rather than simply increase difficulty.

sources.title: V-JEPA 2.1
sources.finding: Dense predictive training improves visual representations. Better representations are a starting point for building a world model; they are not by themselves evidence of a useful language-model organ.
sources.author_direction: Scale training and use the new features to build world models, with fine-grained robotics and navigation as directions.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Test action-conditioned predictions and their use by a receiver separately. We do not need to train a large video model to test the interface question.

sources.title: Launch-Bound and Substitutable
sources.finding: In the tested OLMoE quantization setting, restoring original routes explains little of the quality loss. Changing fewer routes is not a reliable quality measure. The causal replay result is model-specific.
sources.author_direction: Remove a router-quantization confound in DeepSeek, test expert batching, and judge routing interventions by output quality rather than route-change counts alone.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Measure routing effects at fixed input signals. Our proposed signal-strength comparison is our hypothesis, not an experiment requested by these authors.

sources.title: Causal and Interpretable Structures in LLM Compositional Tasks
sources.finding: The authors separate an intermediate relation from a final answer and transplant that relation while preserving the recipient context. An orderly representation can still be causally unused.
sources.author_direction: Extend beyond cyclic tasks with three variables, examine mixed concepts and investigate neurons. Sampling becomes expensive as the number of variables grows.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Intermediate transfer already has direct precedent. A private-information test must explain a specific failure or success beyond demonstrating another connection.

sources.title: Revisiting Model Stitching in the Foundation Model Era
sources.status: Accepted at CVPR 2026; arXiv version checked
sources.finding: In vision models, training a connector to match receiver features can help. Connecting the receiver to itself is an important comparison. A weaker source does not always help a stronger target.
sources.author_direction: Develop task-agnostic hybrid vision backbones and extend the resource-conscious stitch-tree design.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Compare interface-training recipes with matched capacity, examples and compute. Account for different supervision, and include a receiver self-connection. Vision results motivate this test but do not establish language transfer.

sources.title: The Mouth is Not the Brain
sources.status: ICLR 2026 World Models workshop paper, per arXiv metadata
sources.finding: An energy-based model connects to frozen GPT-2 through a trained adapter to generate product reviews. This models structured attributes, rather than changes through time.
sources.author_direction: Test time-series data, more stable alternatives such as variational autoencoders, better evaluation, and other domains and languages.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Energy-plus-language is already prior work. To claim an energy-model benefit, compare matched alternatives on prediction and downstream use. Our GPT-2 work remains paused.

sources.title: Cross-Model Stitching Transfers Answers, Not Computation
sources.finding: Task-trained linear connectors in the tested same-family language models mainly transfer first-answer information. This is not a theorem that all model composition must fail.
sources.author_direction: Cross-family transfer and whether other stitches can transmit missing computation remain open.
sources.direction_kind: Explicit author direction or open limitation
sources.our_experiment_change: Hide the later question from the sending organ and connector. A reusable state message could then answer several questions, but this would still show information transfer, not transfer of an algorithm.

decision: First explain routing sensitivity of the working supplied-answer channel. Later test private-state reuse under a query hidden from the sender. Defer a full world-model comparison until both prediction and receiver competence can be tested.
limitations: All 96 existing cells are exposed development data.
The next routing study is a fixed sensitivity panel, not a recovered native mechanism or a resolved dose-response curve.
No new experimental result or publication novelty is established.
